_note: Curated from CassiopeiaQ/W/E/R BIN. Q (Noxious Blast) TooltipTotalDamage = BaseDamage + 0.65 AP -- tooltipOnly is metadata only, doesn't block resolution (same precedent as Thresh R 'The Box'). W (Miasma) DamagePerSecond is a per-tick value of an escapable poison cloud (CloudDuration=5s); curated as ONE tick (Brand P conservative-DoT precedent), tagged Zone. E (Twin Fang) has TWO damage terms: BasicDamage (unpoisoned target) scales by mLevel1Value/InitialBonusPerLevel keyed to CHAMPION LEVEL (1-18), but SkillDamage.ComputeCalcDamage always evaluates a non-P slot at the real ABILITY rank (1-5) -- a genuine engine rank-convention mismatch, so BasicDamage is left uncited (would silently under/over-scale). BonusPoisonedDamage (poisoned target, the common case since Cass applies poison via Q/W first) uses the rank-indexed BonusDamage/BonusAPRatio DataValues correctly and is curated instead (Darius-R-style 'assume the intended combo state' choice). R (Petrifying Gaze) RDamage = RBaseDamage + 0.5 AP, tagged BurstCeiling (Cass's biggest single nuke). Passive (Twin Fang / Deadly Cadence -- PercentHasteMod) is pure ability-haste scaling, no damage.
_noteE: E FIXED + POISON TOGGLE (loop 479, user asked for a Twin Fang empowered toggle). The old curation used BonusPoisonedDamage as E entire damage, and the BIN says that calc is the BONUS ALONE - BonusDamage[1..5] = 20/45/70/95/120 plus BonusAPRatio - while the base lives in a separate BasicDamage = 52 +4/level plus BasicAPRatio. So E was simultaneously DROPPING its base damage and ASSUMING the target was poisoned. Live wiki (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Cassiopeia, fetched 2026-08-21): non-poisoned 52-120 by level +10% AP, poisoned 52-120 +20/45/70/95/120 +65% AP - i.e. base always, bonus only when poisoned. Curated as two hits: BasicDamage unconditionally, and the bonus behind VsDebuffed with no calc of its own, because the unmet state is that it does not happen rather than a smaller number. VsDebuffed is UserAssumed - enemy debuff state is not in the Live Client API - so the floor is the un-poisoned value and the checkbox raises it, with the range spanning both.
